_comment: Known defects in click-free UIA harvester captures, applied at load time by tools/hpt_parse.load_scalar_jsonl. The harvester mispairs name<->value on some panels (adjacent-control association drift). Corrections are keyed by the capture's own (category, desc, name) fields so join keys stay untouched; only values are repaired. Each entry documents the evidence.

corrections.evidence: All three UIA captures (stock 1.3/0.7, trailering 1.3/0.7, hd2500 1.25/0.75) show Min > Max; the desktop tune24 capture (real ParameterIDs 2536/2537, full descriptions) shows the correct GM convention Max=1.3 / Min=0.7. The attached group caption 'Min MAP vs. BARO' is itself misattached, confirming association drift on this panel. Audited 2026-08-25.
